name: MegaProxy
tagline: Private VPN client for HTTPS, MASQUE α and SSH servers you control
blurb: MegaProxy is an open-source Android VPN client for reliable and secure connections through proxy servers you control or trust.
description:
MegaProxy is an open-source Android VPN client for reliable and secure connections through proxy servers you control or trust.

MegaProxy uses Android's VpnService to route application traffic from all apps or selected apps through an encrypted connection to a user-configured HTTPS, MASQUE (HTTP/3), or SSH proxy.

It contains no advertising, analytics SDKs, tracking identifiers, or remote telemetry. Connection statistics and diagnostic logs remain on the device unless you explicitly choose to share them. Profiles are stored locally; connection credentials are used to authenticate to the configured servers.

Features include:

• HTTPS proxies over TLS using CONNECT without intercepting application traffic

• Experimental MASQUE α over HTTP/3 with multiplexed TCP CONNECT and CONNECT-UDP

• HTTP/2 CONNECT multiplexing with automatic HTTP/1.1 fallback

• Two HTTPS proxies in sequence with HTTPS with Jump

• SSH transport and SSH through a jump host

• Password and unencrypted private-key SSH authentication

• Global VPN and per-application split tunneling

• Android Always-on VPN integration

• DNS-over-HTTPS with configurable providers and fallback

• Configurable HTTPS, MASQUE TLS/QUIC and SSH client fingerprints

• Multiple profiles, import, export, diagnostics, and automatic failover

• English and Russian interfaces

MegaProxy does not provide a proxy service. You need HTTPS, MASQUE or SSH servers that you operate or trust. HTTPS and SSH support a jump server.

HTTPS and SSH forward TCP only. MASQUE α also forwards UDP, with QUIC datagram-size and server interoperability limits. Browser fingerprints approximate TLS/QUIC handshakes; they do not reproduce all browser behavior.
